title: Auto Team Chat
description: This client mod allows you to use shortcuts for switching between team and global chat
body:
# Auto Team Chat

A lightweight Fabric mod that automatically redirects your chat messages to your team channel by default, while still letting you drop a message in global chat with a single character.

---

## 🎯 Overview

On team‑based servers - Factions, Bed Wars, SkyBlock co‑op, and more - mis‑sent messages can cost you victories and spoil strategies. **Auto Team Chat** solves this by:

- **Defaulting** every message to your team chat command (e.g. `/teammsg`)  
- **Reserving** a single‑character override (`!`) to send global chat  

No more typing long commands or worrying if you slipped into the wrong channel!

---

## ✨ Features

- **Automatic Team Chat**  
  Every chat you type (e.g. `Hello team!`) is sent to `/teammsg Hello team!` by default.

- **Global Chat Override**  
  Start your message with `!` (e.g. `!Hello everyone!`) to send it as a normal global chat message; the `!` is stripped automatically.

- **Client‑Side Only**  
  No server plugin required - install on the client and go.

- **Lightweight & Fast**  
  Written in pure Fabric, minimal impact on performance.

- **Broad Compatibility**  
  Works on Minecraft **1.16.5 → 1.21.x** with Fabric Loader & Fabric API.

---

## 🚀 Why You'll Love It

- **Zero Mistakes**  
  Avoid accidentally broadcasting private team tactics to the whole server.

- **One‑Key Global Chat**  
  No need to reach for `/msg`, `/say`, or chat toggles - just `!`.

- **Focus on Gameplay**  
  Spend less time typing and more time building, fighting, or looting.

---

## 📥 Installation

1. **Install Fabric Loader** (any recent version) and **Fabric API**.  
2. Download `AutoTeamChat‑<version>.jar` from the [Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/project/auto-team-chat).  
3. Move the JAR into your `mods/` folder.  
4. Launch Minecraft on the Fabric profile.
